therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: participants with high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma after surgical resection

results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean Cmax 365 µg/mL on Day 1 Cycle 1, steady-state Cmin levels achieved by Cycle 8 (203 µg/mL)
biomarker_changes: 29.3% of participants developed anti-therapeutic antibodies to atezolizumab
safety_signals: 94.4% of participants experienced adverse events vs 79.1% in observation arm
Serious adverse events included atrial fibrillation, myocardial infarction, adrenal insufficiency, hypophysitis, hypothyroidism

context.duration: up to approximately 50 months treatment, 80 months follow-up
